verdict.rationale: Aider supports a limited event-trigger pattern via --watch-files, where comment-based instructions in code trigger AI edits automatically, plus scripting hooks (--message, Coder.run) for programmatic invocation. However, there is no general-purpose rules engine for defining custom triggers/conditions/actions across arbitrary events (e.g., on-commit, on-schedule, on-file-type). missing for 10: a documented rules/automation framework with configurable event types and conditional actions, evidence of multi-event trigger chains, and independent confirmation of reliability beyond the single watch-files use case.
